label: Network Traffic Pro
summary: Advanced load-balancer, global-routing and overlay-network orchestration with reviewed listener/upstream policies, measured checks and staged changes across qualified providers. CDN cache/content delivery is owned by CDN Management Pro, DDoS-response policy by DDoS Defense Pro and workload placement by Multi-server Hosting Pro.
core_boundary: Core retains baseline IP/network/firewall administration, native gateway/provider foundations, management-access recovery and the seven essential engine adapters. This module coordinates advanced traffic policy through accepted owned operations, not arbitrary scans, tunnels, raw firewall commands or a competing routing authority.
acceptance: Map public/private listeners, routing authority, certificates and allowed upstreams before accepting a traffic plan.
Qualify protocol, source-address, timeout and health semantics for each selected provider combination.
Test management lockout prevention, failed configuration checks, lost connectivity and supported rollback.
Constrain probe and tunnel destinations, rate limits and credentials; reject metadata/control-plane reachability.
Disable new automation without removing current routing or the Core's independent network recovery route.
